title: Hakari Steps Into The Light — Part 3

series.summary: The chaos collapses into comedy, then Hakari takes the center of the crowd and her bright smile starts drifting somewhere far away.

segments.voiceover_text: The whole competition dissolves into nonsense around him. Rentaro stares dead ahead, sweating quietly, and decides the safest move is saying nothing.
Then one voice cuts clean through it. Hakari steps forward with her fists at her chest, and every head in the crowd turns.
A small girl drops flat onto the bricks, laughing so hard she cannot stand up. For a moment nothing here hurts anybody.
Hakari gathers her in close and looks out across the hills. The smile stays put, but her eyes have already gone somewhere else.
